name: Park North Shopping Center
summary: Park North Shopping Center is a well-established community destination on San Antonio's Northwest Loop 410, offering a practical mix of retail stores, dining options, and essential services including banking and healthcare. With over 7,000 reviews and a 4.4-star rating, this accessible center serves as a convenient hub for everyday shopping needs in the northwest San Antonio community.
demographics: Park North Shopping Center serves a diverse, middle-income demographic in San Antonio's northwest corridor, attracting families and working professionals from the surrounding residential neighborhoods. The trade area encompasses a mix of household compositions, with a strong presence of Hispanic and multi-generational families seeking convenient access to everyday services and dining options. Visitors typically range from young adults to seniors, with median household incomes in the $40,000-$70,000 range, drawn to the center's practical mix of banking, healthcare, retail, and casual dining establishments that cater to routine shopping needs rather than luxury purchases.
description: Park North Shopping Center has served as a cornerstone of San Antonio's northwest community along Loop 410 for decades, providing residents with a convenient hub for everyday needs and services. This well-established community center brings together a diverse mix of retail stores, restaurants, bars, and essential services including banking and healthcare facilities, creating a one-stop destination for local families and professionals. The center's strategic location on Northwest Loop 410 ensures easy accessibility for the surrounding neighborhoods, making it a natural gathering place for the community. With a solid 4.4-star rating from over 7,000 reviews, Park North Shopping Center has earned its reputation as a reliable and valued shopping destination. The center's extended operating hours from 8:30 AM to 9:30 PM accommodate busy schedules, while its mix of national retailers and local businesses reflects the practical, service-oriented needs of San Antonio's northwest residents.
